title: Add partial fill manual external close and crash restart lifecycle tests
description:
Add end-to-end lifecycle integration tests in tests/integration/test_position_cycle_restart.py and a verification audit document in docs/verification/phase_m_lifecycle.md. Together they exercise the cycle FSM (mike_trade/portfolio/cycles.py), the coordinator (mike_trade/portfolio/manager.py), reconciliation (mike_trade/execution/reconcile.py) and projections (mike_trade/portfolio/status.py) as a unit. This is a verification task: write only tests and the audit artifact, and change no production code.

Before editing, inspect: mike_trade/portfolio/cycles.py, mike_trade/portfolio/manager.py, mike_trade/execution/reconcile.py, mike_trade/portfolio/status.py, the persistence layer and the test fixtures for temporary SQLite databases, the fake broker/shadow adapters and the fake clock used in existing tests. Do not modify any of them.

Required scenarios. Use a temporary SQLite database, a fake broker port and a fake clock; no network and no credentials:
1. Partial entry fill: a buy for N shares fills k < N, and the remaining quantity is then canceled. The cycle retains k, consumes exactly one entry slot, requires protection for exactly k, and never re-buys N-k.
2. Partial exit fill: a full-quantity discretionary sell partially fills. Remaining quantity and protection quantity update, and no buy is possible until confirmed flat.
3. Manual close bypasses the minimum hold: an operator close inside the minimum-hold window is accepted and closes the full remaining quantity.
4. External/manual close detection: the broker position goes to zero without a locally initiated sell. After reconciliation the exit is audited as external/manual, not a strategy win, and the budget is released only once no linked orders remain.
5. Crash restart mid-cycle: persist state while BUY_PENDING with a fill that occurred at the broker during downtime. Rebuild the coordinator from SQLite, run reconciliation, and assert that the missing fill is applied exactly once, entries stay blocked until protection is confirmed, and a duplicate BUY signal after restart creates no second entry.
6. Crash restart with an unknown broker order or missing stop: the symbol stays RECONCILING and entries are blocked.
7. External holdings: a pre-existing broker position appears as UNMANAGED in the status projection and is not adopted.
8. Pause: with the operator pause active, fills and protection updates still apply and new entries are blocked.

docs/verification/phase_m_lifecycle.md must list each scenario, the test function that covers it, the invariant it proves, and the exact targeted pytest command used. It must state that no live or paper broker orders were placed. Record actual pass/fail results; do not claim results that were not observed. Any scenario that cannot pass because of a defect in production code must be marked as xfail with a reason and reported as an open defect in the doc, not fixed in production code.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/test_position_cycle_restart.py contains at least one test for each of these 8 scenarios: partial entry fill, partial exit fill, manual close bypassing minimum hold, external/manual close detection, crash restart with a missing fill, crash restart with an unknown order or missing stop, UNMANAGED external holdings, and pause semantics
The crash-restart test rebuilds state from a temporary SQLite database (not in-memory objects carried over) and asserts the missing fill is applied exactly once
The tests assert that no second entry is created after restart when a duplicate BUY signal arrives
The tests assert that the external/manual close is audited as external/manual and not as a strategy exit or win
The tests use only fake broker ports, a fake clock and a temporary database, with no network access and no credentials

docs/verification/phase_m_lifecycle.md maps every scenario to its test name and invariant, records the exact targeted pytest command and observed results, and states that no live or paper orders were placed
Any test marked xfail has an explicit reason that is also listed as an open defect in the verification doc
No production source files are modified; only tests/integration/test_position_cycle_restart.py and docs/verification/phase_m_lifecycle.md change
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
create live or paper broker orders or access broker credentials
fabricate or claim verification results that were not observed
run broad full-suite tests or backtests
